description: Call this when someone asks how to handle a job loss or job search, for example "how do I negotiate severance", "what do I do first after a layoff" or "how do I network". Finds NextChapter’s plain-language guides on layoffs and job search: severance, unemployment, resumes and ATS, networking, LinkedIn, interviews, career pivots, executive search. Returns the guide title, a short answer and its link.

question.description: The question or topic, e.g. "how do I negotiate severance".

name: find_career_guide
title: Find a career guide
